newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African committee to probe forward forex cover.
newsitem.headline: S.African committee to probe forward forex cover.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel said on Friday he had appointed a committee to investigate the provision of forward cover in the foreign exchange market, in view of heavy losses this year.
"Billions of rands was added to the government's debt portfolio in the process mostly without a proper public debate being had about the matter," he told a conference here.

"The government cannot allow this situation to continue and has therefore appointed a committee of Reserve Bank and department of finance officials to make recommendations regarding adjustments to the provision of forward cover.
"The main focus of the investigation will be directed at the long-term forward cover component."

The Reserve Bank's stated aim is to withdraw gradually from the forward forex market. But that plan was disrupted by the fall in the rand this year which triggered a scramble for cover that could only be met by the central bank.
Bank Governor Chris Stals said at the end of August that the Bank's net oversold foreign exchange position had risen to over $15 billion from $8.1 in February.
